test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

In the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, Member States express their commitment to protect the planet from __degradation__ and take urgent action on climate change.
solution: The correct answer is "**degeneration**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • **Degradation** involves the reduction in quality, value, or degree of something, often in relation to environments, materials, or moral integrity. • **For example:-** "The **degradation** of natural resources is a key environmental concern." • **Degeneration** is a process where something declines or deteriorates over time, often in terms of biological health or structure. • **For example:-** "Environmental activists are worried about the **degeneration **of the planet’s natural habitats." Hence, **the correct answer is: 'Degeneration'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Option 1 -** "pollution"** means the presence or introduction into the environment of a substance or thing that has harmful or poisonous effects. (किसी ऐसे पदार्थ या चीज़ की पर्यावरण में उपस्थिति या परिचय जिसका हानिकारक या जहरीला प्रभाव हो) • Option 2 -** "hazard"** means a danger or risk. (ख़तरा) • Option 4 **- "approval"** means the action of officially agreeing to or accepting something as satisfactory. (किसी बात को संतोषजनक मानकर आधिकारिक तौर पर सहमत होने या स्वीकार करने की क्रिया) 30:T7ea, The correct answer is "**that Ben will done.**"
